_source.note: PublicationPayload as decidiq's register loader builds it: the base schema deep-merged with the register.d fragments (enum lists united). Copied, not read across repositories. Refresh it when decidiq changes one of these files.

PublicationPayload.title: PublicationPayload
PublicationPayload.description: Derived, immutable public payload (publish-decisions-via-opencatalogi). Constructed ALLOW-LIST style by PublicationPayloadService: one polymorphic shape discriminated by oriType (Besluit / Vergadering / Verslag). Carries OpenRaadsinformatie-mapped fields alongside schema.org annotations so OpenCatalogi/OR public-API consumers receive ORI-compatible data without a bespoke harvester. By construction this schema contains NO UID fields, NO contact details, NO individual vote records, and NO voter identities: decision payloads carry vote TOTALS only, agenda payloads omit confidential items, minutes payloads render attendance per the body's policy. Anonymous visibility is governed by the OpenRegister RBAC published-predicate: the authorization.read rule grants the public group read access when publicationDate <= $now; publishing sets publicationDate on the payload instance, withdraw sets depublicationDate. The live source object is never published.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set to a date in the past, this payload is live and anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group RBAC rule publicationDate <= $now). Set by PublicationService on publish; never written by clients.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, this payload is withdrawn from public access. A future value schedules automatic depublication via the OpenRegister published-predicate. Set by PublicationService on withdraw.

oriType.title: ORI type
oriType.description: OpenRaadsinformatie record type: interprets the payload ORI-compatibly.

schemaOrgType.title: Schema.org type
schemaOrgType.description: schema.org annotation matching the ORI type (ChooseAction / Event / CreativeWork).

title.title: Title
title.description: Public title of the published output.

bodyName.title: Body name
bodyName.description: Display name of the governance body (no UID).

payloadVersion.title: Payload version
payloadVersion.description: Version of this payload (mirrors the PublicationRecord).

text.title: Decision text
text.example: De raad besluit de Programmabegroting 2026 vast te stellen.

decisionDate.title: Decision date
decisionDate.description: Date the decision was made (Besluit). ORI: besluitdatum.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: Legal article or regulation (Besluit). ORI: juridischeGrondslag.

voteTotals.title: Vote totals
voteTotals.description: Aggregate vote tally ONLY: for/against/abstain counts. NEVER per-member votes or voter identities (Besluit).

for.title: Votes for
for.description: Aggregate count of votes in favour.

agendaItems.title: Agenda items
agendaItems.description: Ordered, non-confidential agenda items (Vergadering → AgendaPunt). Confidential items and their document references are stripped during construction and never appear here.

oriType.title: ORI type
oriType.description: OpenRaadsinformatie record type of the agenda item.

order.title: Order
order.description: Position of the agenda item on the agenda.

title.title: Title
title.description: Public title of the agenda item.

papers.title: Papers
papers.description: The public papers of this agenda item. Papers of an item under confidentiality, and papers labelled confidential, are never listed.

title.title: Title
title.description: The file name of the paper.

url.title: Download link
url.description: The public link to download the paper.

type.title: File type
type.description: The media type of the paper, such as application/pdf.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Attendance rendered per the body's policy (Verslag): either aggregate counts or names of role-holders only, never NC UIDs or contact details.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: Attendance-rendering policy applied (aggregate counts or named role-holders).

presentCount.title: Present count
presentCount.description: Number of attendees present, used when the policy renders aggregate counts.

roleHolders.title: Role-holders
roleHolders.description: Named role-holders rendered when the body's policy discloses individual attendance.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: What was published: an agenda, a decision, minutes or a calendar entry. Citizens filter on it.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the meeting takes place, as residents read it on the calendar.

audiences.title: Audiences
audiences.description: Who the meeting is for, taken from its kind of meeting.
